notes.body:
With this change, running

**time ./tools/check_apis.py -p epan/dissectors/\*.c**

takes around 2.5s on my laptop. This change will likely make the pre-commit hook check take slightly longer as it currently calls this script once for each file that is part of the change, I believe will be quicker for the pipeline or developers running the script locally.
Hm, I don't understand the ruff check errors...
For the first error it looks like you need to pass `result` to `check_included_files`. For the second one the error string needs to be an f-string.
Yes, was rushing, and ran ruff locally on the wrong branch..  Should be ok this time.
